added.member: og model measure, og model process: issues
added.summary: `issues` lists every defect at once (open, non-manifold or flipped edges, degenerate or repeated triangles, floating pieces, a triangle, colour or texture budget the look states and the model is past), each with the option that fixes it; process adds `next`, the command to run after it. Parts of a program that only touch are an assembly, not an issue.
Repeated, compares every view in one call: each view's facts in `views`, ranked by `byIou`, `byAspect` and `byColour` (rankings, no thresholds). `--image <png> --view <view>` is as before.
